label: Dither Dissolve
blurb: The swap happens through a hard ordered dither, no soft blending anywhere: pixels flip from one shot to the other in the fixed pattern of a printer's screen, so the middle of the handover looks like a halftone of the two pictures laid over each other. Choose a fine two by two grid, a classic four by four or eight by eight ordered screen, scanlines, or a loose random speckle, and set how big a dither cell is on screen.
